messages.subject: Inverse Select All in checkboxGroup
parts:
Hi,

Something that seems a little backwards to me with checkboxGroups is that when you set it up to select all the possibilities in the script you have to "un click" each one if you're only interested in a single value. I want all data to be present in the app with out the check box's being selected.  Then with a single click I can get to a single subset and add to it as I continue to click other values in the check box. By the way you can get this functionality by using selectInput and setting parameter "multiple" to TRUE but if you like the look of the check box this is a decent hack for small data sets. 

So, let's say there are 4 years of data and a Prediction variable with values "buy" and "sell". I make the Year and Prediction variable my values in a checkboxGroup in ui.

 checkboxGroupInput("vyear",
label=h5("Year"),choices=list(
"2012"="2012", "2013"="2013", "2014"="2014","2015"="2015")
),
 checkboxGroupInput("vpredict",
label=h5("Predicted"),choices=list(
"Buy"="buy","Sell"="sell")
)

Then I wrap this input in a reactive statement in server with conditions to select all data if the input is null.  

dataset <- reactive({
 sb <- subset(dataset, if(is.null(input$vpredict)){Predict %in% c("sell","buy")}
   else{Predict %in% as.character(input$vpredict)})

 sb1 <- subset(sb, if(is.null(input$vyear)){Year %in% c("2012","2013","2014","2015")}
   else{Year %in% as.character(input$vyear)})
})

When the app launches, you will see all data and if I'm only interested in 2015 I can filter the app to just that subset with only 1 click.  You will need a new subset built on the previous subset if you want have multiple variables in checkboxGroups that will have the same functionality, hence sb and sb1 above.

Hope it helps

Thanks
